description: This file defines a Fragment named HomeFragment used for a TV application frontend built with Android's Leanback library. It constructs a home screen with a custom top navigation bar, a hero banner carousel, and multiple content rows including 'Continue Watching', 'For You', and live TV channels. It also includes custom presenters for banners and landscape cards, as well as data models for navigation items and content entries.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main Fragment building the TV home screen with multiple rows and navigation.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Data class representing each navigation item in the top pill-shaped navigation bar.

classes.name: BannerItem
classes.description: Data class representing items in the hero banner carousel.

classes.name: LandscapeItem
classes.description: Data class representing items in landscape content rows.

classes.name: BannerPresenter
classes.description: Presenter for displaying banner carousel items using a custom BannerView.

classes.name: LandscapeCardPresenter
classes.description: Presenter for landscape content cards with focus effects.

classes.name: SimpleItemDiff
classes.description: DiffUtil callback for optimizing list updates, potentially for future use.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates ViewHolder instances for banners or landscape cards.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to views in ViewHolders.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder

methods.name: buildRows

methods.name: applyWindowInsets
